parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds extracted from document CHEMBL5606458. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching the document, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
